task_instance: Author a production-ready Grafana dashboard definition (as code) for monitoring a REST API service using the RED method: a stat panel for total requests, time-series panels for request rate, error-rate percentage, and P95 latency, a table panel for service up/down status, plus namespace and service template variables and color thresholds; accompanied by a file-provider provisioning config.
evidence: The skill's core deliverable is Grafana dashboards authored as JSON (Dashboard as Code) plus provisioning config, all text artifacts needing no code execution or binary output. Produced dashboards/api-monitoring.json: a complete Grafana dashboard model (uid, title, tags, schemaVersion 39, refresh, time window, templating.list with two query variables namespace and service, and a panels array). Panels follow the skill's patterns and the RED method: id 1 stat 'Total Requests' with reduceOptions/calcs lastNotNull and absolute threshold steps green/yellow/red; id 2 timeseries 'Rate' using sum(rate(http_requests_total[5m])) by (service); id 3 timeseries 'Errors' computing 5xx percentage with a red threshold at 5; id 4 timeseries 'Duration' using histogram_quantile(0.95, ...); id 5 table 'Service Status' on up{} with an organize transformation renaming instance/job/Value. All PromQL targets are scoped by the $namespace and $service variables as the skill prescribes, and each panel has a non-overlapping gridPos and a description. Also produced provisioning/dashboards.yml matching the skill's file-provider example (apiVersion 1, provider 'default', folder 'Production Monitoring', type file, updateIntervalSeconds 10, allowUiUpdates true, options.path under the Grafana dashboards directory). Verified by re-reviewing the written files: the JSON is well-formed (balanced braces/brackets, comma-correct) and conforms to the Grafana dashboard schema fields shown in the skill, and the panel set covers every structural element the skill documents (stat, timeseries, table panel types; template variables; thresholds; provisioning). Files: /tmp/claude-0/-home-user/b273891e-4b73-5af7-9840-fc512af93809/scratchpad/real2_work/r283/dashboards/api-monitoring.json and /tmp/claude-0/-home-user/b273891e-4b73-5af7-9840-fc512af93809/scratchpad/real2_work/r283/provisioning/dashboards.yml. Not loaded into a live Grafana instance (would need a running Grafana/Prometheus service and account), but the skill's stated deliverable is the dashboard definition itself, which exists and is verified.
